hosting: Official project media streamed over HTTPS; only full-frame posters are stored in this repository.
note: These clips are recorded research demonstrations. They are not new experiments, a controlled comparison, or live model inference on this webpage.

groups.title: 3D assets
groups.kicker: From an image to an object
groups.description: Turntable views reveal generated shape and appearance.

items.title: A colorful cottage in 3D
items.description: A single-image 3D result shown as a rotating textured cottage. The official project identifies the conditioning image as DALL·E 3 generated.
items.attribution: Jianfeng Xiang et al., TRELLIS: Structured 3D Latents for Scalable and Versatile 3D Generation. Official project demonstration.
items.rightsNote: The official TRELLIS page restricts its materials to academic and research purposes and excludes commercial exploitation. Video remains hosted by its authors; the full-frame poster is extracted and converted to WebP for this research survey.

items.title: A gallery of generated 3D assets
items.description: Twenty generated objects rotate in the official image-to-3D gallery, revealing their appearance from changing viewpoints.
items.attribution: Jiaxiang Tang, Zhaoxi Chen, Xiaokang Chen, Tengfei Wang, Gang Zeng and Ziwei Liu, LGM: Large Multi-View Gaussian Model for High-Resolution 3D Content Creation. Official project demonstration.
items.rightsNote: Video streamed directly from the authors' official project host. No separate video reuse licence is asserted. The credited poster is a complete frame extracted at 0.8 seconds, resized without upscaling, and converted to WebP.

groups.title: Spatial scenes
groups.description: Explore scene expansion and camera-controlled novel views.

items.title: A text-generated cave walkthrough
items.description: A first-person sequence moves through a generated dark cavern with rocky surfaces and pools of water, extending the scene along the camera path.
items.sourceLocator: Text-driven scene generation · cave and water
items.attribution: Rafail Fridman, Amit Abecasis, Yoni Kasten and Tali Dekel, SceneScape: Text-Driven Consistent Scene Generation. Official project demonstration.
items.rightsNote: Video streamed directly from the authors' official project host. No separate video reuse licence is asserted. The credited poster is a complete frame extracted at 0.8 seconds, resized without upscaling, and converted to WebP.

items.title: Camera-controlled novel views
items.description: The original montage pairs camera trajectories on the left with generated views on the right, across a car, an astronaut, a laptop, and a cat.
items.attribution: Wangbo Yu, Jinbo Xing, Li Yuan, Wenbo Hu, Xiaoyu Li, Zhipeng Huang, Xiangjun Gao, Tien-Tsin Wong, Ying Shan and Yonghong Tian, ViewCrafter: Taming Video Diffusion Models for High-fidelity Novel View Synthesis. Official project demonstration.
items.rightsNote: Video streamed directly from the authors' official project host. No separate video reuse licence is asserted. The credited poster is a complete frame extracted at 0.8 seconds, resized without upscaling, and converted to WebP.

groups.title: Dynamic worlds
groups.description: Time-varying 3D content and recorded world-model responses.

items.title: A bear driving through time
items.description: A text-to-4D result prompted as a bear driving a car. The original paired visualization shows generated content over time and changing viewpoints.
items.sourceLocator: 4D Generation · a bear driving a car
items.attribution: Sherwin Bahmani et al., 4D-fy: Text-to-4D Generation Using Hybrid Score Distillation Sampling, CVPR 2024. Official project demonstration.
items.rightsNote: Video streamed directly from the authors' official project host. No separate video reuse licence is asserted. The credited poster is a complete frame extracted at 0.8 seconds, resized without upscaling, and converted to WebP.

items.title: Keyboard-conditioned world exploration
items.description: An official third-person demonstration in which keyboard inputs steer a generated walk through a cherry-blossom schoolyard. This is a recorded research demo.
items.attribution: Team HunyuanWorld / Tencent Hunyuan, HY-World 1.5 (WorldPlay), official third-person demonstration.
items.rightsNote: Video streamed from Tencent Hunyuan's official project host. The repository/model licence is not asserted as a separate video reuse licence. The credited poster preserves the full source frame, including the keyboard-input overlay.

groups.title: XR experiences
groups.description: Spatial editing and generated responses to tracked interaction.

items.title: Edit objects inside VR
items.description: A spatial editing interface applies natural-language instructions to an object, with a preview before full-fidelity processing. The original on-screen annotations are retained.
items.attribution: Cyrus Vachha et al., Dreamcrafter: Immersive Editing of 3D Radiance Fields Through Flexible, Generative Inputs and Outputs, CHI 2025. Official project demonstration.
items.rightsNote: Video streamed from its official host. The project footer declares the website CC BY-SA 4.0; no separate clip-specific licence is asserted. The poster preserves the full frame, resized and converted to WebP.
items.audioNote: AAC track is silent: full-clip FFmpeg volumedetect mean and peak -91 dB.

items.title: Hand-conditioned play with a cat
items.description: A first-person generated scene depicts hands moving a cat toy while a cat reacts. The source system conditions generation on tracked hand and head poses; this clip is a recorded output.
items.attribution: Linxi Xie, Lisong C. Sun, Ashley Neall, Tong Wu, Shengqu Cai and Gordon Wetzstein, Generated Reality, 2026. Official project demonstration.
items.rightsNote: Video streamed directly from the authors' official project host. No separate video reuse licence is asserted. The credited poster is a complete frame extracted at 0.8 seconds, resized without upscaling, and converted to WebP.
